games.name: The Ayuwoki Field
games.desc:
You are trapped at the Ayuwoki's field. There's no way to escape, just stay away from him and you'll be fine. How many nights will you survive?

This game is a mix between "El Bosque del Ayuwoki" by NahuelP25 and "THE RAKE: Classic Edition" by RVVZ.

Note for the english speakers that play this Roblox experience:
This game is originally in spanish, so when I add new text I have to translate it into english, and let's just say that sometimes I forget to translate it and.. yeaahh.. sorry if you find any text in spanish.

Music used:
Menu: Alice Mako - Dragon Riders
Intermission: Alice Mako - Stress Relief; Alice Mako - Flying Fortress II; Alice Mako - Some Patterns 14
Night: Kevin MacLeod - Gathering Darkness
Chase: Amnesia - Suitor Attacks

The game was remade on October 1, 2023.

games.name: Steel Titans
games.desc:
Steel Titans is one of the most realistic and historically accurate tank games on Roblox with over 160 tanks to choose from!


Controls:
WASD- move
Left click- Fire
Right click- Scope view
123- Change selected ammo for primary gun
456- change selected ammo for secondary gun
Space- Fire secondary gun(s)
E- spot
Q- binoculars
Tab- view score menu
X- X-ray to view modules
C- Turret lock
V- change view
T- toggle special action

games.name: Hoopz [ANIME EVENT🔥⚡] (Basketball)
games.desc:
PS5, XBOX and CONTROLLER support is here!

(CONTROLS):
L1/LB - Decrease Power
R1/RB - Increase Power
L2/LT - Switch Handles
R2/RT - Shoot Ball
L3 (Click left stick) - Toggle shift-lock
R3 (Click right stick) - Zoom in and out
X - Behind the back (Left to right side)
B - Behind the back (Right to left side)
Y - Dunk
A - Jump
DPad left - Left half behind the back
DPad right - Right half behind the back
Select Button/Back Button - Manuever through menu

Yes, this is a sentence with the word Basketball so that it would show up on ROBLOX's search engine... lol
